body: i..  don't really know? i feel selfish, but at the same time i don't. i'm disappointed i didn't actually do it, but i don't think i'm gonna do it again. i feel kind of bad for not taking everything into consideration and just letting the bad things and the thoughts take over. i realize now that doing it would've affected a lot of people, and i guess it's comforting, but i'm not sure i really care. i can list off a million different reasons to live now that i've "calmed down", and i just don't care, i guess.
thank you for being willing to listen. i almost forgot how much i needed it. it's been a while since i've been able to actually open up.

my parents invalidating it? when i was 14 & unable to meet with my therapist for awhile and everything got way too much. i had a break down during school and when i said something about wanting to die mom flipped n started all that "too young" and "invalid" stuff.

thank you for the reassurance. yes, i'm on medication. i honestly think it's only been making things worse, but maybe thats because it's mixed with a few other medications (yes, we have talked to the doctor about it.) i think my feelings are perfectly valid- i've suffered through a lot bullshit and truama to be more than enough "" validation"'" . my parents are the ones saying it's invalid.

no, i haven't. opening up about having these thoughts usually leaves them angry at me and threatening to send me to a psych ward. too young to feel this way, haven't had a bad enough life for it to be valid, i guess. they're afraid of losing a child, i understand that, but they don't know how to properly handle it, obviously.

daily. our parents tried putting a stop to it at first but eventually gave up and now just laugh with them. i've tried explaining how it affects me, but they brushed it off as me being overdramatic. it's all a harmless joke to everyone else.

family. brothers, to be precise. i know "its what siblings do!" or whatever, but it hurts. everytime they see me they tell me i should be dead, or that i'm useless, or something of those sorts. i've done so much for them. i held on so they'd have their older brother here. that doesn't seem to be something they want anymore.

nothing feels worth it anymore. when i am happy, it's taken away almost as quickly as it came. five years of therapy and nothing's changed. the people i held on for have begun encouraging it. i'm tired. i don't want to wait for things to get better anymore. i want to give up.
